edits.new:
Then the move is refused and nothing changes; the refusal message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4022-APP-AC11)

  Scenario: AC8 Business rules BR1 to BR10 hold (new; NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4022-APP-AC6)
    Given the service is built and its boundary and guardrail tests are in place
    When the boundary and guardrail tests run
    Then each rule BR1 to BR10 of section 8 holds, or the build fails

  Scenario: AC9 Error answers 401, 403 and 404 (new; NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4022-APP-AC7)
    Given a request to a provided operation without a login, with a role lacking the right, or for an unknown case
    When the operation answers the request
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 as the failed check requires and nothing is read or written

  Scenario: AC10 Replay of a write (new; NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4022-APP-AC8)
    Given a write with an idempotency key has been answered
    When the same write arrives again with the same idempotency key
    Then the write is not repeated, the first answer is returned and no second record is written (BR8)

  Scenario: AC11 Activity retry and timeout (new; NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4022-APP-AC9)
    Given a consumed contract call misses 2 s or the activity times out
    When the activity is run
    Then the activity is retried on the workflow schedule and the answer is 503 (X5)
